title: Penalties.
bodyText: Penalties and interest shall be added to and become a part of the tax, when and as provided by section 231-39.
bodyHtml: §238-10  Penalties.  Penalties and interest shall be added to and become a part of the tax, when and as provided by section 231-39. [L 1965, c 155, pt of §2; Supp, §119-10; HRS §238-10]
